_comment: P-091 reviewed skill sinks (tests/test_skill_sinks.py). Each entry is one line where built text reaches a subprocess or os command without codec_applescript: the file, the stripped line text, and why it is safe or, for a KNOWN GAP, what is still open. An entry covers every identical line in that file. Add an entry only after reading the code; remove it when the line changes or goes (the test fails on stale entries).

sites.line: url = site_url if site_url.startswith("http") else "https://" + site_url
sites.reason: One argv item for open -a <browser>, no shell: the URL is the http(s) link or domain found in the request, or a SITE_ALIASES entry.

sites.line: selector = f"role:AXButton name:{name}"
sites.reason: One argv item for the ax_bridge binary, no shell or AppleScript; the name only narrows which UI element ax_bridge picks.

sites.line: selector = f"role:AXTextField name:{name}" if name else "role:AXTextField"
sites.reason: One argv item for the ax_bridge binary, no shell or AppleScript; the name only narrows which UI element ax_bridge picks.

sites.line: selector = f"role:AXButton name:{name}" if name else "role:AXButton"
sites.reason: One argv item for the ax_bridge binary, no shell or AppleScript; the name only narrows which UI element ax_bridge picks.

sites.line: safe_url = 'https://' + safe_url
sites.reason: One argv item for open -a Google Chrome, no shell; quotes and backslashes are stripped above and codec_browser_policy.check_url (P-101) runs before the call.

sites.line: url = "https://" + word
sites.reason: Becomes safe_url below: one argv item for open -a Google Chrome, no shell; quotes and backslashes are stripped and codec_browser_policy.check_url (P-101) runs before the call.

sites.line: set URL of active tab of front window to "{url}"
sites.reason: url is the Google search address plus urllib.parse.quote_plus(query): quotes, backslashes and line breaks are percent-encoded, so nothing leaves the literal.

sites.line: make new tab at end of tabs of front window with properties {{URL:"{url}"}}
sites.reason: url is the Google search address plus urllib.parse.quote_plus(query): quotes, backslashes and line breaks are percent-encoded, so nothing leaves the literal.

sites.line: do script "echo ''; echo '\\033[38;2;232;113;26m━━━ CODEC FILE SEARCH ━━━\\033[0m'; echo ''; echo '{safe}'; echo ''"
sites.reason: KNOWN GAP, follow-up: the request text and the found file paths are only shell-quoted; a double quote or backslash in either can end the AppleScript do script literal. Local path only (MCP returns before this).

sites.line: ok = _send(recipient, body)
sites.reason: The only call of _send: recipient passed _validate_recipient just above and again at the top of _send (a phone number of + and digits, or an email of word characters, dot, plus, minus and @); no quote or backslash. The body goes through codec_applescript.

sites.line: f'tell application "Terminal" to do script "cat {tmp.name} && echo && echo \\"Press Enter to close\\" && read && rm {tmp.name}"'
sites.reason: tmp.name is NamedTemporaryFile(dir='/tmp', prefix='codec_memory_', suffix='.txt'): letters, digits, underscore and dot only, no quote, backslash or space.

sites.line: ["screencapture", "-x", "-R", f"{left},{top},{w},{h}", path],
sites.reason: Screen rectangle for screencapture -R as one argv item, no shell: left and top are int(), w and h are integer defaults.

sites.line: iface = f"en{i}"
sites.reason: Constants only: en0 to en9 from range(10), one argv item, no shell.

sites.line: do script "echo ''; echo '\\033[38;2;232;113;26m━━━ CODEC NETWORK ━━━\\033[0m'; echo ''; printf '{safe}\\n'; echo ''"
sites.reason: KNOWN GAP, follow-up: the result is only shell-quoted; a double quote or backslash in the joined Wi-Fi network's name (or the ipify reply) can end the AppleScript do script literal. Runs on every call, MCP included.

sites.line: out = "/tmp/.codec_hue_%d_%d.json" % (_os.getpid(), int(_t.time() * 1000) % 1000000)
sites.reason: %d of two integers (process id and a time counter): a fixed /tmp file name passed as one argv item, no shell.

sites.line: result = _apply_state(ip, user, target_type, target_id, state)
sites.reason: The light or group id goes only into the bridge URL, one sys.argv item of the python -c relay in _launchctl_request whose program is a constant; no shell or AppleScript.

sites.line: return _run_once(task, ip, user)
sites.reason: The bridge address and user from the Hue config go only into the bridge URL, one sys.argv item of the python -c relay in _launchctl_request whose program is a constant; no shell or AppleScript.

sites.line: return _run_once(task, new_ip, user)
sites.reason: The address from codec_hue_discovery and the configured user go only into the bridge URL, one sys.argv item of the python -c relay whose program is a constant; no shell or AppleScript.

sites.line: f'display notification "Timer: {display} is up!" with title "CODEC" sound name "Glass"'], timeout=5)
sites.reason: display is built only from the integer seconds in this function (for example 5 minutes).

sites.line: _show_in_terminal(f"{target} Translation", "\\n".join(body_parts))
sites.reason: KNOWN GAP, follow-up: the request text and the model's reply reach the Terminal do script literal with no escaping at all; a double quote ends the AppleScript literal and a single quote ends the shell quoting inside Terminal. Local path, non-Latin targets only (MCP returns before this).

sites.line: subprocess.run(["osascript", "-e", f"set volume output volume {new}"], timeout=5)
sites.reason: Integers only: new is min/max of the current volume (int) plus or minus 15, so 0 to 100. Covers the same line in the volume down branch.

sites.line: subprocess.run(["osascript", "-e", f"set volume output volume {v}"], timeout=5)
sites.reason: Integers only: v is min(100, int(...)) of the digits the regex matched.
